title: Grandpa's Shed
wikitext:
{{Location Infobox |image = Grandpas Shed Fixed }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a new [[Buildings|Farm Building]] added to the Farm by Stardew Valley Expanded. When using one of the custom [[Farm Maps]], the shed has a designated spot on the map. For all other vanilla and custom farms, the Shed is added as a new location accessible off the [[Stardew:Bus Stop|Bus Stop]] map. Initially the shed is broken down and cannot be used by the player. Completing Robin's [[Quests|"Grandpa's Shed" quest]] makes the shed available for use. {{TOC|limit=2}} ==Quest== To trigger Robin's quest, simply enter the Shed to start an event. Robin tells the farmer that she can refurbish the shed with the right materials. To complete the quest, deposit the following to the trunk located on the first floor: * {{NameSDV|Stone|600}} * {{NameSDV|Hardwood|150}} * {{NameSDV|Iron Bar|50}} * {{NameSDV|Battery Pack|20}} ==Interior Use== Once Robin finishes the construction, both floors of the shed become available for use. The first floor can be used as storage, for machines, and even allows [[Stardew:Cask|Casks]] to be placed there. The second floor has a greenhouse space that functions the same way as the regular [[Stardew:Greenhouse|Greenhouse]]. ==Shed Locations== {|class="wikitable" |- ! Image !! Farm Map !!
